name: ClaudeConfigCard
srcDivergence: Deliberate, not stale — read end to end against the file, and all four kinds of difference are by construction. (1) DATA: the file destructures `projectLocalRepos`, `bscBaseDir` and the profile CRUD from `useAppStore()` and derives `allRepos` via `deriveAllRepos`; the preview has no store, so the record holds `SAMPLE_REPOS` / `SAMPLE_PROFILES`. (2) TYPES: the record drops annotations such as `useState<string[]>([])` and `(profile: ConfigProfile)` because those types come from modules that do not resolve in the sandbox — they erase at compile time, so this changes nothing at runtime. (3) DEFENSIVE STUBS: the record wraps the `read_claude_config` call in a `typeof result.then === “function”` guard and reads `profile.instructions ?? “”`, because its stubbed `invoke` need not return a promise and its sample profiles are untyped — the file can assume both. (4) COMMENTS: the file's section comments are absent, which is documentation rather than content. The rendered card is unchanged. Hand-reviewed for `record-src-reconcile`.
